id.description: Unique in the map; links and run frames name it.

title.description: What it does, in a few plain words: Check the tree.

type.description: instructions: the assistant reads and follows it; code: a script runs; screen: something the person sees, reads or clicks.

by.description: Who does it when it is not the assistant itself: one helper per file, all at once.

source.description: Where it is written: a file and section (SKILL.md · Phase 1) or a script (scripts/tree.py validate).

match.description: How a run is recognised as being in this step: substrings of a tool call (a script name, a file path, a command, a tool name).

lane.description: Layout hint: the column. Absent = automatic.

row.description: Layout hint: the row. Absent = automatic.
